description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 
 
 
 Job Description 
Think working in insurance can't be exciting, rewarding, and challenging? Think again.Allstate extends beyond insurance to provide customers with protection across many aspects of their lives.

Team Overview

The ALLIE Portfolio Management and Product Execution team plays a critical role in advancing Allstate’s AI-enabled business strategy by connecting portfolio priorities, business objectives, technology, and execution. As part of ALLIE, Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem, the team develops and enables technology solutions that help translate strategic goals and complex business needs into actionable insights, products, and capabilities.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, data, analytics, finance, and business teams, we build scalable solutions that improve how portfolio decisions are made and executed. This includes leveraging AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices to create intelligent capabilities that improve visibility, identify risks and opportunities, support prioritization, and enable better business and customer outcomes.

Our team enables a high-performing, user-centric culture that empowers employees to deliver valuable customer outcomes. We leverage modern engineering practices including Agile development, test-driven development, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 

 Partner with engineering leaders and product managers to deliver technology solutions that support business and customer needs.
 Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable applications using Python and modern development practices.
 Contribute to product backlogs by delivering features, resolving defects, and improving overall application quality.
 Support the adoption of AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), vector database technologies, and related capabilities across products.
 Participate in product discovery, technical design, and solution architecture discussions.
 Contribute to Azure cloud-based solutions and help implement scalable, reliable, and secure architectures.
 Support the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines, automation, testing, and deployment processes.
 Collaborate with architecture, platform, data science, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
 Promote documentation standards, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices.
 Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
  
 Essential Skills 

 7+ years of software engineering experience designing and developing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, and ReactJS .
 Experience designing, building, and scaling cloud-native applications , microservices , and distributed systems .
 2+ years of experience with AI/ML , Generative AI , LLM-based applications , intelligent agents , prompt engineering , Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , vector databases , and AI service integrations .
 1+ years of experience leading small to medium-sized engineering teams and managing external stakeholders.
 Experience with modern DevOps , CI/CD , observability , site reliability , and production operations practices.
 Experience leading architecture design , technical strategy , and cross-functional engineering initiatives .
 Strong understanding of software design patterns , API design , system scalability , performance optimization , and cloud-native architectures .
 Experience working in Agile development environments and mentoring engineers on technical best practices.
 Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
   
 Supervisory Responsibilities 
 This job does not have supervisory duties
 
 #LI_NJ1
 
 
 Skills 
Agile Methodology, Agile Methodology, Agile Software Development, Analytics, Business, Business Process Modeling, Business Software, Business Strategies, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Based Solutions, Cloud Computing, Cloud Native, Collaboration, Computer Science, Continuous Delivery, Data Science, Design, DevOps, Ecosystems, Engineering Practices, Java (Programming Language), Machine Learning (ML), Microsoft Azure, Product Management, Python (Programming Language) {+ 8 more} 
 
 Compensation 
Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications. 
 The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation. 
  
 Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

 Allstate provides a comprehensive technology setup, including a laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse. Employees eligible to work from home also receive a monthly connectivity reimbursement to help offset internet costs.
  
 When working from home, you must have a dedicated, private workspace free from distractions, along with appropriate desk and seating. Reliable internet is required, with minimum speeds of 50 MB download and 5 MB upload.
  
 To help create a more personal and engaging experience, we ask that you join with your camera on if your interview is virtual. Please also have a Valid Photo Identification available at the start of your interview.  If you require any accommodations or have questions ahead of your interview please reach out to your recruiter.
  
 Note: Internal candidates are only asked to join on video; a Valid Photo Identification is not needed for the interview.
